baseline.rust_build: rustc 1.96.0; cargo build --locked --release; upstream release profile

baseline.limits: Shared throttled laptop; not controlled Linux acceptance or final optimized candidate. Baseline precedes JIT correctness fixes, which do not execute in this VM run.
baseline.method: Seven sequential samples per case/language, rotating language order. Measured loop only. First three production, QuickSort test size. Explicit default VM. No own compilation or profiling overlapped timing samples.
baseline.goose_build_environment: Installed SDK C++ header directory supplied via CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-isystem /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/usr/include/c++/v1; no Goose source edits.

provenance.method: Seven rotating rounds, five variants, sequential samples. Same unchanged four inputs as original comparison. Measured loop excludes preparation/warmup/checksum/compile; process wall time also retained. No concurrent benchmark/build/profiling work by this task. Shared laptop; no idle-host guarantee.
